description: 106-107年中央行政機關室內公共區域免費手機充電站查詢服務 [electricity and power] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 數位發展部. 行政院及所屬各級機關(構)、全國各地方縣市政府為提升為民服務品質，及滿足民眾外出活動或洽公等候的手機充電需求， 於各地選定部分iTaiwan熱點近處設置免費手機充電站，包含洽公場所、旅遊景點、交通運輸節點、文教館所、公立醫院等，提供民眾免費手機充電服務，民眾可利用本資料集查詢且快速找到免費手機充電站的相關資訊。 【本資料集已停止更新】. Coverage: Taiwan. The portal files it under the publisher 數位發展部. Its tags are 公共資訊. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2025-12-23 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
